    def test_kernel_ring_buffer(self, ssh_command):

        dmesg_output = "\n".join(ssh_command.run_check("dmesg"))
    
        # Critical error patterns to check
        critical_patterns = [
            r"Out of memory",

            r"hung task",
        ]
